name: King's Wood Creation
old_description: We take your vision and put it to paper to bring you a rendering of your future kitchen. We then apply our years of knowledge to make it the best kitchen for you. From there, it's a breeze to your new space.
about:
King's Wood Creation operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it began over two decades ago as a one-man shop. The company has grown into a full-scale woodworking facility producing custom cabinets, doors, mantels, beams, furniture, and architectural millwork.

The shop runs CNC machinery alongside traditional woodworking equipment to fabricate kitchen and bath cabinetry, fireplace mantels, ceiling box beams, hand railings, and custom furniture. Services include design rendering, finishing, and carving, with the ability to source specialty timber on demand. The facility serves both one-off custom pieces and repeat production runs for builders.

Clients range from residential homeowners to building professionals such as contractors, architects, and interior designers. The company has supplied millwork for new construction, remodels, and custom home projects throughout the Phoenix area.

King's Wood Creation emphasizes material selection and in-house CNC capacity as differentiators, stating that it selects only the finest timber and can procure specialty woods as needed. The firm holds an Arizona Registrar of Contractors license (ROC #340054) and markets its products as proudly designed and produced in the USA.
